dimensions.name: Autonomous operations
dimensions.blocker: No clean streak of repeated unattended end-to-end production jobs yet; real customer-style runs still surface new failure classes.

dimensions.name: Operational reliability
dimensions.blocker: Production runs still require too much incident-driven repair across state, provider, timeout, provenance and recovery paths.

dimensions.name: Customer fulfillment
dimensions.blocker: The full intake-to-delivery workflow exists, but a clean paid end-to-end customer completion has not yet been demonstrated.

dimensions.name: AI / agent capability
dimensions.blocker: Routing, model/tool use and worker execution are strong, but tool discovery, provider limits and orchestration edge cases still appear in real runs.

dimensions.name: Website Builder maturity
dimensions.blocker: Generated-site quality and workflow completeness are materially improved, but repeated 9.5+/10 unattended production-quality completions remain unproven.

dimensions.name: Acquisition readiness
dimensions.blocker: No repeatable customer-acquisition channel or proven lead-to-paid conversion loop exists yet despite live offer, SEO and lead-handling surfaces.

dimensions.name: Business / economic proof
dimensions.blocker: No verified paying Stromation customers or recurring revenue yet; venture economic proof remains limited.

changed: The forecast is now decomposed into ten independently scored dimensions. The main new visibility is that Stromation's technical and commercial layers are already strong while operational reliability, repeated autonomous execution and acquisition remain the largest gaps.
method: Expanded independent forecast grounded in the Sep. 10 main-branch implementation and live-run evidence. The original four-metric historical snapshots remain unchanged; this companion file adds finer-grained current and projected dimensions. Forward-looking values are estimates, not guarantees.
